title: Test a flavor's own pickle guard by saving without delegating to the wrapped flavor
answers: test for pickle guard passes even when the check is removed
how to test shap explainer load guard
save explainer with serialize_model_using_mlflow False in test
fixture delegates to sklearn so guard test is meaningless
body:
Symptom: A test for a flavor's pickle guard keeps passing after the guard is deleted.
Root cause: tests/shap/test_log.py fixture shap_model is sklearn-backed, so loads enter the sklearn loader and hit its existing guard before mlflow/shap/__init__.py:_load_explainer runs.
Fix pattern: Save with mlflow.shap.save_explainer(..., serialize_model_using_mlflow=False) so the load goes straight to _load_explainer. Set MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false via monkeypatch and assert pytest.raises(MlflowException, match='MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION'). Parametrize over mlflow.shap.load_explainer and pyfunc.load_model.
Constraints: Confirm the test fails when the guard is removed. This only holds when the wrapped model would otherwise be loaded by another flavor's loader; it does not apply to explainers that are not sklearn-backed.
applies: Tests in tests/shap/ and similar flavor tests that exercise a guard in a loader which another flavor can shadow.
says: Explainer model loading tests pass even when pickle deserialization protection is completely removed.
Security checks for loading model explainers are masked by underlying framework loaders during testing.
Ensure explainer security tests directly verify their own pickle deserialization protection.
Tests for explainer deserialization guards give false confidence because underlying models shadow them.
search: When testing a model flavor's pickle guard such as mlflow/shap/__init__.py:_load_explainer, save the explainer using mlflow.shap.save_explainer with serialize_model_using_mlflow=False. This prevents sklearn-backed fixtures from delegating to sklearn's loader and masking the flavor's own loader check in tests/shap/test_log.py:test_load_disallows_pickle_deserialization. Tests must set MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false, parametrize over mlflow.shap.load_explainer and pyfunc.load_model, and confirm failures when the guard is removed.
